property.value:
[Trait] COLOSSAL INDIFFERENCE If Starro began the game on the 20-point starting line, it can't attack smaller characters except via Colossal Retaliation.
[Trait] MY MINIONS PROTECT ME Friendly characters with "(Starro's Minion)" in their name can use Willpower. At the beginning of your turn, if Starro took damage since your last turn, choose a friendly character with "(Starro's Minion)" in their name. This turn, that character has "FREE: Make an attack."
[Speed] WARP LOYALTY Powers: Sidestep, Mind Control Sidestep, Mind Control. When Starro uses Mind Control, you may KO a Starrophyte bystander adjacent to an opposing character. If you do, Starro may target that opposing character regardless of range and line of fire. // Targets of Starro's Mind Control modify defense -1 for each Starrophyte bystander adjacent to them.
[Attack] STARRO'S SPREAD Whenever Starro hits, generate a Starrophyte bystander adjacent to each hit character. // POWER: Generate 3 Starrophyte bystanders. // At the beginning of your turn, if there are 6 Starrophyte bystanders on the map, heal Starro 1 click. // Maximum 6 Starrophyte bystanders on the map. (You may generate up to that number.)
[Defense] COLOSSAL RETALIATION: THE STAR CONQUEROR Powers: Stop STOP. FREE: If no other Colossal Retaliation power has been activated this turn, choose an opposing character that attacked Starro or damaged a friendly character since your last turn. Place Starro such that it can make an attack targeting the chosen character, then Starro can use Mind Control at no cost, but must target that character (may choose other targets as normal).
[Damage] TENTACLE ATTACK POWER: Make up to five close attacks. Characters may not be targeted more than twice during this action. After resolutions, choose one for each character that was hit during this action: place that character adjacent to Starro -or- heal Starro 1 click.
